intents.label: Buy a home
intents.kateAsk: Hi {firstName} 👋 I noticed you've been looking at home loans lately. Are you planning to buy a home? I can put together your complete plan, from budget to keys.

intents.label: Prepare for a baby
intents.kateAsk: Hi {firstName} 👋 Congratulations if there's a little one on the way or just arrived! Would you like a checklist for insurance, savings and child benefits?
intents.kateSuggest: Hi {firstName} 👋 I can make sure your little one is covered: insurance, child benefits and a savings plan, in one go.

intents.label: Prepare for retirement
intents.kateAsk: Hi {firstName} 👋 You've been looking at pension savings. Would you like to see where you stand for your retirement?
intents.kateSuggest: Hi {firstName} 👋 I can build your retirement plan: pension savings, tax benefits and investments, at your pace.

intents.label: Lower energy costs
intents.kateAsk: Hi {firstName} 👋 Would you like to see how much you could save on energy with insulation, a heat pump or solar panels?
intents.kateSuggest: Hi {firstName} 👋 I can show you the energy upgrades with the best payback for your home, including grants.

intents.label: Renovate a home
intents.kateAsk: Hi {firstName} 👋 You've been checking renovation costs and grants. Are you planning to renovate? I can tell you which grants apply and who can quote.
intents.kateSuggest: Hi {firstName} 👋 Want me to line up the renovation: costs, grants, quotes and financing in one plan?

intents.label: Start a business
intents.kateAsk: Hi {firstName} 👋 I see you've been exploring Start it @KBC and business topics. Are you thinking of starting your own business? I can set up everything you need, step by step.
intents.kateSuggest: Hi {firstName} 👋 It looks like you're launching as a freelancer ({evidence}). Shall I prepare your start-up plan: business account, invoicing, payments, accountant and protection?

intents.label: Switch to an electric car
intents.kateAsk: Hi {firstName} 👋 You've been looking at electric cars. Are you thinking of switching? I can plan the loan, insurance and a home charger together.
intents.kateSuggest: Hi {firstName} 👋 Shall I put your EV switch in one plan: loan, insurance, charger and energy contract?
